_meta.description: Seed data for the disease_lookup table. Each entry drives zone classification, predictive risk alerts, and spread-prediction logic.
_meta.notes: cropping_calendar_bridge: pest/pathogen persists between main seasons via off-season/volunteer crops acting as a 'green bridge' (e.g. rice tungro virus, TN/AP border). risk_factors are plot-level checkable inputs beyond weather that sharpen scoring.

weather_risk_patterns.rust_type: Cool temps (10-27C) + wind-dispersed. Near-calendar-predictable seasonal windows.
weather_risk_patterns.oomycete_blight_late: Cool + very wet (10-21C, 90%+ humidity). Needs free moisture on leaf surface.
weather_risk_patterns.alternaria_blight_early: Warm + humid (24-29C, 70%+ humidity). Opposite temp band from late blight - model separately.
weather_risk_patterns.powdery_mildew: Moderate temp + high humidity but DRY leaf surface. Can worsen in dry spells with humid nights - does not follow the 'less rain = less risk' rule other fungal diseases do.
weather_risk_patterns.bacterial: Rain-splash + physical/insect wound as entry point. Risk score should rise when insect activity (thrips etc.) is also reported nearby, not from weather alone.
weather_risk_patterns.soil_borne_wilt: Cumulative rainfall + poor drainage over time, not a single-day weather trigger. Model as risk_factor (drainage_quality_poor) rather than weather_triggers.

pathogen_type_guidance.bacterial: Enters via wounds (tools/insects/weather) or natural openings. Hard to treat once internal - advisory should emphasize prevention (pathogen-free seed, hot-water seed treatment, soil solarization) over cure once confirmed.
pathogen_type_guidance.fungal: Enters via wounds, stomata, water pores; wind-spread spores. Generally treatable if caught early - fungicide + sanitation advisory appropriate.
pathogen_type_guidance.viral: Spreads via plant-to-plant contact, soil, seed, pollen, insects. Almost impossible to cure once infected - advisory should NOT suggest a treatment/cure step. Recommend resistant variety for next season + isolate/remove affected plants to prevent spread. Quarantine as last resort at scale.
pathogen_type_guidance.nematode: Soil-based. Crop rotation and soil treatment are primary levers; chemical nematicide only if threshold crossed.

_meta.headline_stat: India loses an estimated 30% of crops, worth Rs 90,000 crore annually, to pests and diseases; plant diseases alone account for nearly one-third of total production losses. (Source: industry analysis, cited in Kshema General Insurance blog, 2024)

diseases.name: Yellow Rust
diseases.regional_source: Himalayan region (via Barberry host) migrating south on northerly winds into NW India plains
ipm_steps: Use resistant/tolerant wheat varieties where available
Spray recommended fungicide (e.g. Propiconazole) at first sign
ipm_steps_hi: जहाँ उपलब्ध हो वहाँ रोग प्रतिरोधी/सहनशील गेहूँ की किस्मों का उपयोग करें

पहला लक्षण दिखते ही अनुशंसित फफूंदनाशक (जैसे प्रोपिकोनाज़ोल) का छिड़काव करें
दिसंबर-मार्च के दौरान हर सप्ताह खेतों की निगरानी करें

compound_risk_rules.effect: thrips feeding injury significantly raises purple blotch infection incidence and severity - boost purple blotch risk score when thrips sighted

cross_crop_alert_rule.description: When a disease's crops[] list has more than one entry (e.g. anthracnose_multi), a confirmed outbreak on any one listed crop should raise the risk score for OTHER listed crops within the same or adjacent villages, not just the same crop type.
